checks.knownLocalFailure: tests/git-sync-credentials.spec.mjs, reports a credential the host refuses as an authentication failure: the local Git 2.54.0 classifies the refusal as unknown; no Git sync code changed in this release, and CI passes the test
checks.verifyPlugins: passed in CI on Node 24 for #443; locally Node 22 npm 10.9.4 fails with an arborist error while resolving the artifacts' peer sets, before any test runs
checks.releaseCheck: passed: starter 0.5.34 on latest, dsh-mnemon-source-skills 0.5.1 in the composition
checks.releaseIntent: passed: the consumed changeset covers dsh-mnemon and dsh-mnemon-source-skills
checks.peerFloors: dsh-mnemon-source-skills keeps the dsh-mnemon peer range ^0.5.33: every SDK and client name it imports exists in 0.5.33
checks.lockfile: two specifiers change: the Starter pin of dsh-mnemon-source-skills (0.5.0 to 0.5.1) and its dsh-mnemon development range (^0.5.33 to ^0.5.34)
checks.publicationUpgradeSmoke: run locally as publish.yml runs it, on the pinned DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 with 0.5.34 served from the accepted candidates: upgrades 0.5.29 to 0.5.34 without changing the Runtime Memory bytes, with the legacy settings import, the disable gate and the three optional Strategies

limits: Before publication npm has no 0.5.34 and no dsh-mnemon-source-skills, so Check versions offered the candidate only because the harness sent its request to the loopback registry; publication and the post-release checks repeat the update against npm itself

No real GitHub sign-in, live model API, embedding service, paid Provider or native Desktop window was exercised in this acceptance; self-evolution was switched on and off but no review ran, since no model was configured

The Check versions dialog, the Skills detail and the full Status page show scratch paths that name the capturing account, so the record crops the dialog above its Profile line, blurs the path in the Skills detail and keeps the Status screenshots above the storage section
